INCRESE

COSTA RICA · GLOBAL MISSION
Equipping emerging, healthy servant leaders focused on living and multiplying the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

Welcome to

INCRESE Costa Rica

Like a seed planted in good soil, lasting transformation begins with what is faithfully cultivated. We believe that when leaders are grounded in the Gospel, shaped by the Holy Spirit, and equipped to serve others, their impact reaches far beyond themselves.

Through a model of cultivation, we invest in emerging servant leaders who strengthen churches, restore communities, and multiply the hope of Jesus across Costa Rica and beyond. Because when leaders grow, the Gospel bears fruit for generations to come.

MISSION

A mission rooted in the Gospel.

To cultivate a movement for the reproduction and multiplication of emerging servant leaders who are focused, healthy, and committed to the Gospel of Jesus Christ, filled with the Holy Spirit.

VISION

INCRESE exists to glorify God by training leaders at every stage of life.
